newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India subdued in jaded London trading.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India subdued in jaded London trading.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts (GDRs) were little changed in London in thin trade as the market felt the impact of a lacklustre day in India and Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's comments late Thursday.
"It is flat and it is dead. There are no flows," said one trader.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR Index rose 0.25 points to 54.71, with the premium over the local market at 15.71 percent compared with Friday's 14.28 percent.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index fell 11.14 points to 2,815.06.
"People are keeping books flat until the end of the year, I just hope 1997 looks better," said the trader.
Indian GDRs are down nearly 28 percent in the year to date.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended up 0.32 points at 60.80, a premium of 32.43 percent over the local market after the Korea Composite Index fell 3.94 points to a provisional close of 692.17.

The Capel Taiwan GDR Index gained 0.32 points to 93.09, a premium of 3.72 percent after the Taiwan Weighted Index rose 29.22 points or 0.43 percent to 6,808.83. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
